name: ANSI/IEEE Phase-loss monitoring relay form
aliases: IEEE Relay Sensing Lack of Phase in Three Phase System
summary: IEEE-library form of phase-loss monitoring relay: a phase-loss relay supervises the presence of the specified phases in a three-phase system.
description: This reference locates phase-loss monitoring relay in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented miscellaneous relays family. A phase-loss relay supervises the presence of the specified phases in a three-phase system. The drawing identifies the monitored source and output used by control or protection logic. The public library uses HCR1F42 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Trace the measured quantity or initiating control signal separately from the output contacts. The device tag links the sensing or operating element to the controlled circuit; settings, reset behaviour and the actual terminal arrangement belong in the selected equipment documentation.

Check whether phase sequence or voltage unbalance is also configured in the selected device. Phase loss is different from phase reversal or current unbalance. The linked functional counterpart explains the same operating role in its own drawing context; agreement of every detailed convention mark is not asserted.
